type Result = ['success', string] | ['failure', Error];
function show(result: Result) {
 const [status, value] = result;
 if (status === 'success') console.log(value.toUpperCase());
 else console.log(value.message);
}
show(['success', 'ok']);
function showPair(...[kind, value]: ['text', string] | ['count', number]) {
  if (kind === 'text') console.log(value.toUpperCase());
  else console.log(value.toFixed());
}
showPair('text', 'ok');
showPair('count', 3);
function pick(flag: boolean): [1, 'a'] | [2, 'b', true] {
  return flag ? [1, 'a'] : [2, 'b', true];
}
const [x, y] = pick(true);
const kx: 1 | 2 = x;
const ky: 'a' | 'b' = y;
const [p, q, r] = pick(false);
const [m, ...rest] = pick(false);
const rr: ['a'] | ['b', true] = rest;
function mixed(flag: boolean): [1, 'a'] | string[] {
  return flag ? [1, 'a'] : ['s'];
}
const [u, v] = mixed(true);
const uu: 1 | string = u;
console.log(x, y, p, q, r, m, rest, u, v, kx, ky, rr, uu);
